section_summary: This section details the postwar custody, administration, and liquidation of Japanese diplomatic archives, funds, and personnel across Europe, Asia, and Washington. It records the proceedings of the tripartite Allied Committee on Japanese Affairs in Portugal overseeing property liquidation, repatriation, and archives preservation in Lisbon, as well as the discovery and inventorying of seized embassy files in Washington, Buenos Aires, Stockholm, and Rome. In addition, it covers high-level discussions between the Department of State, the Central Intelligence Group, foreign governments, and historians regarding the preservation, declassification, and publication of captured wartime records.

subfiles.about: Repatriation list of Japanese officials and annotated inventory of seized wartime films.
subfiles.from: American Embassy, Lisbon
subfiles.summary: Lists 45 Japanese officials and family members repatriated from Lisbon and provides an annotated list of 42 seized documentary, newsreel, and cultural films.
subfiles.title: Repatriation List and List of Films Found at Japanese Legation (Enclosure No. 1 to Despatch No. 1481)
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Minutes of the Allied Committee on Japanese Affairs in Portugal supervising legation liquidation.
subfiles.from: Allied Committee on Japanese Affairs in Portugal
subfiles.summary: Contains minutes Nos. 2 through 9 of the tripartite Allied Committee meeting in Lisbon between November 1945 and April 1947. Discussions cover bank accounts, legation leases, safe custody of archives, repatriation arrangements, auction of automobiles and official property, and final accounting.
subfiles.title: Minutes of the Allied Committee on Japanese Affairs in Portugal (Enclosure No. 2 to Despatch No. 1481)
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Transfer of Japanese consular and diplomatic archive files from FC to SPD.
subfiles.from: FC - Mr. Amshey, Department of State
subfiles.summary: Notifies SPD of the transfer of FC files concerning Japanese diplomatic archives pursuant to instructions.
subfiles.title: Japanese Archives Files
subfiles.to: SPD - Mr. Hibbard, Department of State

subfiles.about: Inventory of Japanese diplomatic documents transferred from FAC to former Japanese Embassy.
subfiles.from: K. Okami, Former Japanese Embassy
subfiles.summary: Inventories packages of seized Japanese diplomatic files from Buenos Aires, Lima, Stockholm, Rome, and the Vatican transferred to custody in Washington.
subfiles.title: Japanese Diplomatic Documents Transferred from Div. of Foreign Activity Correlation
subfiles.to: Mr. Hibbard - SPD, Department of State

subfiles.about: Inventory of Japanese record books and folders in Box No. 2 from Buenos Aires.
subfiles.from: American Embassy, Buenos Aires
subfiles.summary: Lists thirteen black-bound record books and folders 15-28 shipped from Buenos Aires in pouch 5094.
subfiles.title: Contents of Box No. 2 from Buenos Aires (Enclosure No. 2 to Despatch No. 213)
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Inventory of Japanese folders in Box No. 4 from Buenos Aires.
subfiles.from: American Embassy, Buenos Aires
subfiles.summary: Lists folders C-3 to C-20 from trunk III shipped from Buenos Aires in pouch 6758.
subfiles.title: Contents of Box No. 4 from Buenos Aires (Enclosure No. 4 to Despatch No. 213)
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Report on the introduction of the Labor Ministry Bill and inter-ministerial debates in Japan.
subfiles.from: Paul L. Stanchfield, Deputy Chief, Labor Division, ESS, SCAP
subfiles.summary: Discusses Diet introduction of the Labor Ministry Bill, jurisdictional settlements regarding workmen's compensation and unemployment insurance, and ministry budget preparations.
subfiles.title: Monthly Summary of Labor Developments and Labor Ministry Legislation
subfiles.to: Philip B. Sullivan, Division of International Labor, Social and Health Affairs

subfiles.about: Status and inspection of 426 cases of Japanese records held in Changchun.
subfiles.from: Ward, American Consulate General, Mukden
subfiles.summary: Reports Chinese inspection status of 426 cases of Japanese records in Changchun and attempts by local officials to extort squeeze.
subfiles.title: Mukden Telegram No. 248 Regarding Japanese Records in Changchun
subfiles.to: Secretary of State

subfiles.about: Proposed disposition of 4,000 cubic feet of captured Japanese military and naval records.
subfiles.from: Captain C. E. Olsen, Assistant Director, Central Intelligence Group
subfiles.summary: Offers approximately 4,000 cubic feet of screened Japanese War and Navy Ministry records, army files, and ordnance blueprints to government departments before transfer to the National Archives.
subfiles.title: Disposition of Captured Japanese Documents
subfiles.to: Special Assistant for Research and Intelligence, Department of State

subfiles.about: State Department interest in captured Japanese War and Navy Ministry records for research.
subfiles.from: W. Park Armstrong, Jr., Acting Special Assistant to the Secretary
subfiles.summary: Affirms State Department requirement for free research access to Japanese military and naval records upon their transfer to the National Archives.
subfiles.title: State Department Requirements Regarding Captured Japanese Documents
subfiles.to: Captain C. E. Olsen, Central Intelligence Agency

subfiles.about: Routing slip requesting review of CIA memorandum on captured documents.
subfiles.from: Department of State
subfiles.summary: Internal routing slip requesting review and preparation of a coordinated reply to CIA.
subfiles.title: Reference Slip on CIA Memorandum
subfiles.to: R - Special Assistant for Research and Intelligence

subfiles.about: Routing slip referring CIA memorandum to OCD for study.
subfiles.from: Department of State
subfiles.summary: Routes CIA memorandum to Mr. Fearing with instructions to conduct a study and reply.
subfiles.title: Reference Slip to OCD Regarding Captured Documents
subfiles.to: OCD - Mr. Fearing

subfiles.about: Recommendation and draft reply to CIA on captured Japanese documents.
subfiles.from: REF - Mr. Ottemiller, Department of State
subfiles.summary: Recommends a draft reply to CIA emphasizing State Department requirements for policy research access to Japanese War and Navy records.
subfiles.title: CIA Memorandum, September 26, 1947
subfiles.to: OCD - Mr. Fearing, Department of State

subfiles.about: Reporting the loan of Japanese Embassy secret account books and Reeves files to Gosho.
subfiles.from: K. Okami, Former Japanese Embassy
subfiles.summary: Reports that Henry Gosho borrowed two secret account books and 19 letters concerning P. W. Reeves for investigation.
subfiles.title: Documents Borrowed by Mr. Henry Gosho
subfiles.to: Mr. W. F. Chappell - DS, Department of State

subfiles.about: Receipt acknowledging loan of Japanese account books and Reeves correspondence.
subfiles.from: Henry Gosho, Division of Foreign Activity Correlation
subfiles.summary: Receipts 1938 and 1941 Japanese diplomatic account books and 19 letters concerning P. W. Reeves from Okami.
subfiles.title: Receipt for Japanese Embassy Account Books and Reeves Letters
subfiles.to: K. Okami, Division of Protective Services

subfiles.about: Discovery of approximately one hundred classified Japanese official files in Room 5.
subfiles.from: K. Okami, Former Japanese Embassy
subfiles.summary: Reports finding approximately one hundred classified Japanese files in a safe in Room 5 dealing with propaganda, communist lists, trade, and consular conferences.
subfiles.title: Additional Documents Found in Room 5 of the Chancery
subfiles.to: Mr. W. F. Chappell - DS, Department of State

subfiles.about: Requesting search of Washington Document Center files for Netherlands East Indies records.
subfiles.from: Eelco van Kleffens, Ambassador of the Netherlands
subfiles.summary: Inquires whether historical documents from the Netherlands East Indies forwarded via SEATIC are held at the Washington Document Center and requests research access.
subfiles.title: Netherlands Embassy Note No. 5770 on Japanese Documents
subfiles.to: Secretary of State

subfiles.about: Administrative file note requesting flimsy copy be used as the permanent record copy.
subfiles.from: Department of State
subfiles.summary: Notes that the blue memorandum copy was accidentally destroyed and requests the flimsy serve as the official record copy.
subfiles.title: File Note on Destroyed Record Copy
subfiles.to: Department of State Central Files

subfiles.about: Draft transmittal of Netherlands Embassy note to CIA for comments.
subfiles.from: Division of Foreign Activity Correlation (FC:HHGosho)
subfiles.summary: Transmits text of the Netherlands request concerning East Indies documents to CIA, requesting comments to formulate a reply.
subfiles.title: Draft Memorandum to CIA Regarding Netherlands Request
subfiles.to: Central Intelligence Agency

subfiles.about: Draft reply to Netherlands Note No. 5770 concerning SEATIC documents destruction.
subfiles.from: Secretary of State
subfiles.summary: Advises the Netherlands Ambassador that 95 percent of SEATIC documents were destroyed by PACMIRS at Camp Ritchie and outlines survey options for remaining records.
subfiles.title: Draft Reply to Netherlands Note No. 5770
subfiles.to: Eelco van Kleffens, Ambassador of the Netherlands

subfiles.about: Official copy of reply to Netherlands Note No. 5770 concerning SEATIC documents.
subfiles.from: Secretary of State
subfiles.summary: Official copy of diplomatic note explaining PACMIRS destroyed 95 percent of SEATIC records and proposing a survey of remaining files.
subfiles.title: Reply to Netherlands Note No. 5770 Regarding Japanese Documents
subfiles.to: Eelco van Kleffens, Ambassador of the Netherlands

subfiles.about: Policy recommendations on literary and artistic copyright restoration in occupied Japan.
subfiles.from: SANACC / PCC Working Group
subfiles.summary: Recommends restoring sequestered Allied copyright properties in Japan, protecting foreign works, and recognizing postwar Japanese intellectual property rights.
subfiles.title: Policy Conclusions on Literary and Artistic Works in Japan
subfiles.to: Far Eastern Commission Working Group

subfiles.about: Urging establishment of a State Department project to publish Japanese war documents.
subfiles.from: David Owen, Chairman, Department of History, Harvard University
subfiles.summary: Urges the State Department to establish a Japanese War Documents Project modeled on the German project to publish Japanese diplomatic archives.
subfiles.title: Proposal for a Japanese War Documents Project
subfiles.to: George C. Marshall, Secretary of State

subfiles.about: Welcoming Harvard's support for publishing Japanese diplomatic archives.
subfiles.from: G. Bernard Noble, Chief, Division of Historical Policy Research
subfiles.summary: Welcomes Harvard's interest in publishing Japanese diplomatic papers and expresses hope for congressional funding approval by Fiscal Year 1949.
subfiles.title: Response Regarding Publication of Japanese War Documents
subfiles.to: Dr. David Owen, Department of History, Harvard University

subfiles.about: Request to inspect newly discovered Japanese Embassy documents.
subfiles.from: Charles C. Stelle, Division of Research for Far East (DRF)
subfiles.summary: Requests an opportunity for DRF to examine the documents discovered in Room 5 and arrange consultation with Mr. Okami.
subfiles.title: Japanese Official Documents Discovered at Japanese Embassy
subfiles.to: DS - Mr. W. F. Chappell, Department of State

subfiles.about: Receipt for four confidential Japanese diplomatic and economic studies.
subfiles.from: J. Lydman, Acting Chief, Japan Branch
subfiles.summary: Receipts four Japanese studies on US relations, Latin American propaganda, consular conferences, and trade termination from Okami.
subfiles.title: Receipt for Loan of Japanese Documents
subfiles.to: Mr. W. F. Chappell - DS, Department of State

subfiles.about: Detailed CIA report explaining PACMIRS destruction of SEATIC documents.
subfiles.from: Edwin L. Sibert, Brigadier General, USA, Central Intelligence Group
subfiles.summary: Reports PACMIRS destroyed approximately 95 percent of SEATIC documents at Camp Ritchie, suggesting a survey for specific items and transfer to the National Archives.
subfiles.title: Japanese Documents and SEATIC Records Status
subfiles.to: Chief, Division of Foreign Activity Correlation

subfiles.about: Transmittal of Netherlands request to examine captured documents at CIG.
subfiles.from: Charles P. Nicholas, Colonel, G.S.C., Central Intelligence Group
subfiles.summary: Transmits inquiry from Dr. L. de Jong and explains that searching and photostating uncataloged historical documents would be impracticable.
subfiles.title: Netherlands Request for CIG Material
subfiles.to: Special Assistant to the Secretary for Research and Intelligence
